title: Explicit increasing-tuple module-sheaf complex and augmentation
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $r\in\mathbb N$, $U:\operatorname{Fin}(r)\to X.\mathrm{Opens}$ any family and $G$ an $\mathcal O_X$-module [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. For an open $W$, intersection with $W$ is an opens functor. Restriction of rings $\mathcal O_X(V)\to\mathcal O_X(V\cap W)$ and the module-presheaf pushforward construction give an actual module presheaf $P_W$ with $P_W(V)=G(V\cap W)$. Inclusions $W\subseteq Z$ induce restriction maps $P_Z\to P_W$. For the increasing tuples and intersections $W_t$ [def-sc-alternating-cech-total-complex], define the presheaf term $D^k=\prod_{t:\operatorname{Fin}(k+1)\hookrightarrow_o\operatorname{Fin}(r)}P_{W_t}$. Define $d^k$ by the signed sum of face restrictions, with sign $(-1)^j$ on the face deleting position $j$. Pairing the two deletion orders proves $d^{k+1}d^k=0$. The product of restrictions from $G$ to the singleton terms has zero composite with $d^0$. Apply module sheafification degreewise to obtain the sheaf complex $C$, and compose the sheafification unit on $G$ with the sheafified zero-degree restrictions to define $\epsilon:G[0]\to C$. Empty products are included. All data are constructed explicitly; no existence witness is chosen.

proof.text: Construct the intersection presheaf by restriction of the scalar ring and presheaf pushforward. Take the finite product over increasing tuples and define its differential by the signed face restrictions. The face inclusion inequalities are those of the alternating section construction. Pair the two deletion orders by (i,j) mapped to (j,i+1) for j <= i: the resulting tuples and restriction composites agree and the signs are opposite. The two degree-zero faces cancel after composing with restriction from G. This proves both named side-condition theorems without sorry.

Apply the additive module-sheafification functor degreewise to the explicit presheaf complex. Lift its unit on the underlying presheaf of G through the fully faithful forgetful functor, and compose with the sheafified degree-zero restriction map. The proved augmentation side condition and functoriality give the chain map. Mathlib supplies sheafificationAdjunction, left_adjoint_additive and fromSingle0Equiv; no existential choice supplies the complex or its augmentation.
